items.caption: This modern redraw presents 米 in an oracle-bone script style: small marks are arranged around a central stroke, a form associated with a pictograph of scattered grain. The central stroke has been interpreted as a sieve or as a grain stalk.
items.alt: Black oracle-bone-style marks: three short strokes above and three below a long diagonal stroke.
items.selection_reason: The grain-like arrangement illustrates the pictographic explanation, while the accompanying limitation keeps the disputed interpretation of the central stroke clear.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw in an oracle-bone script style, not an image of an excavated inscription. The arrangement supports the grain pictograph interpretation but does not resolve whether the central stroke represents a sieve, a stalk, or another feature.
